# PDF regression fixtures

All fixtures are deterministic, contain no personal information, and are generated by
`npm run fixtures:pdf`.

| Fixture | Test intent |
| --- | --- |
| `type0-no-tounicode-halfwidth.pdf` | Type0 + `UniJIS-UCS2-H` + missing ToUnicode. Markdown and plain text must contain `ICT本部品質技術ｿﾘｭｰｼｮﾝ部ｿﾘｭｰｼｮﾝ第一課` exactly, with no guessed replacement. |
| `normal-machine-readable.pdf` | A normal machine-readable PDF must not be falsely classified as partial. |
| `three-page-range.pdf` | Pages contain `PAGE_ONE_ONLY` through `PAGE_THREE_ONLY`; a selected range must not include markers from excluded pages. |
| `image-only.pdf` | A page with no text object must be classified as OCR-required and failed. |
| `mixed-text-image.pdf` | A text page plus a page without text must be classified separately as mixed and partial. |

The Type0 fixture intentionally omits the font-to-Unicode mapping required for reliable
generic extraction. Its xref and object syntax remain valid so a parser failure cannot hide
the font-mapping regression. Corrupt structure is tested separately as an error path.
